id.description: Stable Search Index ID used by search requests and the Search Tools detail operation. Do not infer the default state from this value; use IsDefault.

description.description: Human-readable description of the Search Index.

isEnabled.description: Whether the Search Index is enabled for use.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the Dataset's default Search Index. This state is separate from the Search Index ID.

created.description: When the Search Index was created.

modified.description: When the Search Index was last modified.

lastRebuildCompleted.description: When the most recent completed rebuild finished, or null when no completed rebuild is recorded.

description: Compact representation of a Search Index and its current operational state.
